summary: Audited plotting.py (516 lines) and make_interactive.py (294 lines) by static reading + py_compile + in-process stub injection (fake matplotlib.use/pyplot and fake plotly.graph_objects), never adding stub files. CONCLUSION: no logic defect found; no code changed. plotting.py verified: DATA_CSV='data.csv' and REQUIRED_COLUMNS=('angle','backspin','p_make'); _read_sweep loads the real 17x17 data.csv (289 rows) and correctly raises on p_make outside [0,1], NaN, wrong row order (angle-outer/backspin-inner), incomplete grid, and missing columns; P reshape matches experiment.py's write order (mean over shots done upstream, no NaN rows dropped); axis units deg/rad/s and viridis low->high colour scale correct; matplotlib.use('Agg') precedes pyplot import; every plot function closes its figure (no 'all' loop leak); selfcheck writes 7 PNGs into a TemporaryDirectory with cleanup. Numeric baselines match ground truth exactly: free peak P=0.770 @ 55 deg / 45 rad/s, three peak P=0.790 @ 45 deg / 37.5 rad/s, vacuum_launch_angle(-4.57->-0.375, v=7.3)=55.665 deg, drag drop free=40.22 cm and three=117.44 cm, ft_dist=4.195 m / tp_dist=6.75 m. make_interactive.py verified: plotly ImportError guard + 'pip install plotly' message; enhance_html injects lang='zh-CN'/title/meta/banner/footer/date and passes through anchor-less input unchanged; UTF-8 write, cdn vs offline(embed) branch, missing-parent-dir guard and --date override all exercised end-to-end (25 trajectories, ~4s); compute_trajectory(51 deg,23 rad/s)=swish; unknown-outcome grey fallback works. Non-blocking observations NOT fixed (no doc proves a wrong behaviour): (1) 'Free throw (4.57 m)' label uses backboard distance while 'Three-pointer (6.75 m)' uses rim-centre distance and plot_free_vs_three uses 4.19 m — docs themselves mix both conventions; (2) vacuum_launch_angle has an unguarded dx=0 division (unreachable with current constants); (3) make_interactive --cdn flag is a documented no-op and a programmatic include_plotlyjs=False would be mislabelled '离线内嵌'. Commands: python -m py_compile plotting.py make_interactive.py (both OK); stub-injected probes for plotting and make_interactive (all passed); read data.csv/data_three.csv headers.
